out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: Electrical service was interrupted during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: The establishment voluntarily closed. Any TCS food that is out of temperature (> 41 degrees F) for more than four hours must be disposed.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Milk in 2 dr upright display cooler, right, front service counter: 45 degrees F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. NOTE: Milk determined to be out of temperature approximately two hours and was relocated to another cooler.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 dr upright display cooler, right, front service counter area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the three vat sink with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. NOTE: bleach was added to the sanitizing compartment of the three vat sink to obtain a concentration of 50 ppm.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Beans, grated mozzarella in ice bath at cookline: 48/49 degrees F. Egg on prep table shelf at cookline: 69 degrees F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth: Eggs were voluntarily displayed by PIC. Other food was determined to be out of temperature for less than two hours. Advised PIC that ice must be added to ice bath as often as necessary to maintain food at <= 41 degrees F, and to maintain the level of ice at least at the same level as the food in the container.
